news.title: Ripple, Stripe-owned Privy partner to bring embedded wallets to XRP Ledger
news.summary: Developers can now build XRPL wallets into apps via Privy, with support for XRP, RLUSD, AI agent payments and x402.

news.title: Tokenized SanDisk bets saw more liquidations than XRP as Asia’s chip rout wipes out $800 million
news.summary: About $800 million in leveraged positions were wiped out over 24 hours, 86% of them bullish. Chip-stock contracts on crypto exchanges took a chunk of the damage.

news.title: Standard Chartered Will Hold Ripple's Stablecoin in Dubai—And Let Clients Trade With It Without Moving It
news.summary: The bank's Dubai branch now offers custody for Ripple's RLUSD stablecoin and plans a link with LMAX that lets institutions post it as trading collateral while the coins stay put.

news.title: Ripple-Backed Evernorth Hits Nasdaq Holding 473 Million XRP Worth Far Less Than It Paid
news.summary: Evernorth's XRPN shares began trading Monday after its SPAC merger closed, but 80% of SPAC investors cashed out first and its XRP stash is worth roughly 40% less than at signing.

news.title: XRP Ledger’s Payment Engine Had a Counterfeiting Bug Hiding Since 2015
news.summary: An integer overflow in the payment engine, dormant since 2015, could have let an attacker mint spendable XRP beyond the token’s total supply.

news.title: XRP treasury Evernorth’s shares rise 5% at Nasdaq opening print
news.summary: Evernorth’s share price rose by 5% as investors welcomed the Nasdaq debut of the first pure-play XRP digital asset treasury.

news.title: Standard Chartered offers RLUSD custody in Dubai and plans LMAX collateral link
news.summary: Ripple previously gave LMAX $150 million in financing to integrate RLUSD into its institutional infrastructure.

news.title: Evernorth names former Coinbase investment exec to steer 473 million XRP treasury ahead of Nasdaq debut
news.summary: Evernorth plans to put its XRP holdings to work through lending, liquidity provision and yield strategies.
